title: Izalontamab brengitecan in recurrent or metastatic esophageal squamous cell carcinoma: the PANKU-Esophagus01 randomized clinical trial
population: 497 patients with recurrent/metastatic ESCC after first-line PD-1/platinum-based therapy.
treatment: Izalontamab brengitecan 2.5 mg/kg IV on days 1 and 8 every 21 days.
summary: Phase III randomized evidence in post-immunochemotherapy ESCC: median OS 9.79 versus 7.20 months (HR 0.63) and median PFS 4.17 versus 1.97 months (HR 0.50). Grade ≥3 treatment-related adverse events were 85.1% versus 59.3%.
absoluteEffect: NNT is not calculated from median OS/PFS or hazard ratios; no verified common fixed-time absolute survival rate is used.
clinicalInterpretation: A recent positive phase III result relevant to sequencing after first-line immunochemotherapy. The high grade ≥3 toxicity rate, regional access and longer-term survival maturity remain important.
criticalReview: The randomized design and dual time-to-event benefit are strengths. Interpret the large toxicity burden and do not convert median survival differences into NNT. NCCN reference/category not verified for this run.
archiveNote: Eligible Trial of the Day: primary publication within the preceding month and absent from the Atlas roster/page/archive/previous ToD.
